goal: Verify that all user-facing screens and interactions work correctly: authentication, project management, document ingestion, RAG chat with all modes, conversation history, and project settings.
note: These are click-by-click UI steps — no Postman or curl needed. Open http://localhost:3000 in the browser before starting.
preconditions_global: docker-compose up -d — all backend services running and healthy
pnpm dev running — frontend available at http://localhost:3000
At least one PDF file ready on disk for upload tests (any medical PDF, e.g. drug leaflet)
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in .env (needed for chat scenarios)

scenarios.title: Login page — initial redirect
scenarios.description: Opening the app without a session should redirect to the login page.
preconditions: Browser has no saved session (open in incognito or clear localStorage)

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000 in the browser
steps.expected: Redirected to /login — login page is displayed with email and password fields

steps.action: Verify page elements
steps.expected: Visible: medRAG branding, email field, password field, 'Sign in' button. No dashboard content visible.

scenarios.expected_outcome: User is on /login and cannot see any app content without logging in

steps.action: Type a wrong password (e.g. 'wrongpass')
steps.expected: Text accepted

steps.action: Click 'Sign in'

scenarios.expected_outcome: Error message visible on the page, user stays on /login
